item.title: NASA's Swift sees a wandering black hole devouring a star with the brilliance of 10 billion suns
item.description: NASA's Swift Observatory observed a supermassive black hole tearing apart a star over 30,000 light-years from a distant galaxy's center.

item.title: NASA's Psyche spacecraft successfully completes Mars flyby with stunning timelapse
item.description: NASA's Psyche spacecraft used Mars' gravity to accelerate toward its 2029 rendezvous with a metal-rich asteroid, capturing a timelapse video.
